1.body:
Hello,

I saw the UX Design Intern opening at Monsoonfish, and I am keen to help your team turn ideas into clean, intuitive digital experiences for clients.

During my time as a UI/UX Designer at AT Creation, I conducted usability testing and fed those findings directly into improved user flows and interface wireframes. I also designed brand guidelines and visual systems that kept revision cycles low.

My case study Bounceless demonstrates my end-to-end UX thinking and wireframing for a B2B verification product, which you can explore in my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

I am based in Nagpur and ready to relocate to Pune for this onsite role. Would you be open to a quick fifteen-minute chat about my UX work?

Ananya

Ananya Saini
+91-8605846929
https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/
